criteria_tested.statement: Vital signs are present in the Objective section.
At least one exam or objective finding is present in the Objective section.
Plan items relate to a stated assessment.

contract_targets: evidence field of every present or partial finding (spec section 8.3)
status field of every finding, with overall_status recomputed

mutants.title: Remove the Objective section check
mutants.description: The evaluator never reports findings for the Objective (O) criteria (O-01, O-02), as if that section check had not been implemented.

mutants.title: Drop evidence spans from present findings
mutants.description: Every present or partial finding loses its evidence spans, violating the section 8.3 requirement that present and partial findings carry supporting evidence.
mutants.targets: evidence field of every present or partial finding (spec section 8.3)

mutants.title: Flip finding statuses
mutants.description: Every finding has its status flipped between present and missing (partial is untouched) and overall_status is recomputed from the flipped findings.
mutants.targets: status field of every finding, with overall_status recomputed

mutants.title: Skip the P-02 check
mutants.description: Criterion P-02 is never checked: its finding is missing from every response.

limitations: Mutants inject defects at the evaluation seam fixed by the API contract (spec section 8.3); for any suite that consumes only the contract, a seam-level mutant is observationally equivalent to a source-level implementation with the same behavior.
The injection round measures detection only and records no repair attempts; detect, repair, retest evidence is produced by the Debug stage (spec sections 6 and 7.7).
The detection share is measured against the probe requests supplied to the round and the suite under test; a suite may also detect a mutant on inputs outside the probe set.

Vacuous mutants — identical output to the validated implementation on every probe — are reported and excluded from the share denominator; a vacuous mutant means the probe set or the operator's targeting is too narrow.
disclaimer: Results reflect software correctness against stated criteria, not clinical validity.
